capabilities: Import selected Distari projects as Markdown papers and notes
Write bibliographic frontmatter (title, authors, year, venue, DOI, tags) on paper files
Rewrite distari:// paper and note links into vault wiki links
Run imports on demand or automatically every 30 minutes
Preserve locally edited files as dated conflict copies instead of overwriting them
disambiguation: Not a two-way sync: imports run only from Distari to the vault, and local edits are never uploaded.
extras: Free plugin; the notes and note-assets API endpoints it depends on are outside Distari's supported public API; iOS is untested; the README gives detailed update, rollback, and privacy guidance.
intentEvidence: Distari maintains this official plugin as a first-party Distari client, including any future community-directory release.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bring research papers and their notes from a Distari account into a vault as linked Markdown files.

relations.evidence: Distari maintains this official plugin as a first-party Distari client

requires.name: Distari personal access token with read scope

summary: One-way importer that pulls Distari papers, summaries, and notes into a vault as Markdown files with bibliographic frontmatter and wiki links.
